name: ARK: Survival Evolved
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The dinosaur survival game: tame, breed and ride over 100 creatures with up to 70 players. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with Workshop mods and a console through RCON.
startup: cd ShooterGame/Binaries/Linux; setsid ./ShooterGameServer "{{SERVER_MAP}}?listen?SessionName={{SESSION_NAME}}?Port={{SERVER_PORT}}?QueryPort={{QUERY_PORT}}?RCONEnabled=True?RCONPort={{RCON_PORT}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}?ServerAdminPassword=$ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD${ARK_PASSWORD:+?ServerPassword=$ARK_PASSWORD}${MOD_ID:+?GameModIds=$MOD_ID}" -server -log -automanagedmods $([ "{{BATTLE_EYE}}" = 1 ] || echo -NoBattlEye) {{ARGS}} & pid=$!; stop() { echo "Saving the world and stopping"; rcon -a 127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}} -p "$ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD" saveworld; rcon -a 127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}} -p "$ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD" DoExit; wait $pid; exit 0; }; trap stop INT TERM; until rcon -a 127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}} -p "$ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD" listplayers >/dev/null 2>&1; do kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null || exit 1; sleep 5; done; rcon -a 127.0.0.1:{{RCON_PORT}} -p "$ARK_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <&0 & wait $!; wait $pid

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ARK: Survival Evolved. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 376030) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves and settings (ShooterGame/Saved) and
# mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-376030}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# The game downloads Workshop mods itself (-automanagedmods) with its own copy
# of SteamCMD, which it looks for in the engine's folder.
ark_steamcmd=Engine/Binaries/ThirdParty/SteamCMD/Linux
mkdir -p "$ark_steamcmd"
[ -x "$ark_steamcmd/steamcmd.sh" ] || cp -r steamcmd/. "$ark_steamcmd/"
mkdir -p Steam/steamapps
ln -sfn ../../../../../Steam/steamapps "$ark_steamcmd/steamapps"
echo "Installed ARK: Survival Evolved build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map, such as TheIsland, ScorchedEarth_P, Aberration_P, Extinction, Ragnarok, Valguero_P or CrystalIsles.

variables.name: Server password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none. Letters, numbers, - and _.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin and RCON password, which the console needs. Letters, numbers, - and _.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Mods
variables.description: Workshop mod IDs, separated by commas, which the game downloads at start.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: The port Steam's server list asks about the server on. Give the server this port.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: The remote console's port, which the server's console here talks to the game through.

variables.name: Extra arguments
variables.description: More server options, such as -crossplay or -ForceAllowCaveFlyers, added at the end.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
